name: Tavernkeep Smitts
summary: At the Scarlet Raven in Darkshire, Tavernkeep Smitts hears the town’s gossip and remembers its unsolved tragedies. His keen eye makes him a valuable contact for those seeking Duskwood’s dark history.

sections.title: Heart of Darkshire
sections.body:
Tavernkeep Smitts tends the Scarlet Raven’s hearth and pours drinks for weary travelers, townsfolk, and nervous Night Watch guards facing Duskwood’s perils. For years, he has been a familiar face in Darkshire, where rumors pass through his tavern each day.

While other townsfolk stay behind locked shutters, Smitts watches who comes and goes. He notices strange patrons, hurried departures, and behavior that does not fit the town.

sections.title: The Memory of Stalvan
sections.body:
Years ago, Smitts joined Marshal Haggard to investigate the slaughter of a visiting Stormwind noble family. At the scene, he found torn, muddy pages from a journal and kept them.

Investigators could not formally link the handwriting to Stalvan Mistmantle then. Smitts kept the faded scraps for years, certain the grim truth would come to light.

sections.title: The Shadowy Patron
sections.body:
Terrified hermit Jitters once took refuge in the Scarlet Raven. There, Smitts saw him scribbling feverishly in a personal diary. Jitters fled in blind panic and left the journal behind.

When an investigator brings it back, Smitts recognizes the book and points the tracker toward Raven Hill. His help unravels the cursed events that plague the woods.

faq.q: Where can I find Tavernkeep Smitts?
faq.answer: Find Smitts behind the counter on the Scarlet Raven Tavern’s ground floor, on Darkshire’s town square.

faq.q: What does Smitts know about Stalvan Mistmantle?
faq.answer: Years ago, Smitts joined Marshal Haggard in investigating the slaughter of visiting nobles. At the scene, he found and kept muddy, torn journal pages. When shown new evidence linking Stalvan to the crime, Smitts gives up the pages to be delivered to Commander Althea Ebonlocke.

faq.q: What does Smitts know about Jitters?
faq.answer: Jitters stayed at the Scarlet Raven, where Smitts saw him write frantically in a journal before fleeing in terror. Bring Jitters’s journal back to the tavern, and Smitts recognizes it and directs you west toward Raven Hill to track him down.

faq.q: What drinks does Smitts brew or request?
faq.answer: Smitts helps procure ingredients for local drinks. He sends adventurers into the cursed wilds for Rot Blossoms to brew a potent mixture known locally as Zombie Juice.

faq.q: Who is Marshal Haggard, and how does Smitts know him?
faq.answer: Marshal Haggard is an old Stormwind Guard veteran who lives in a secluded cottage in the hills. He and Smitts investigated the grisly murders of nobles years ago and formed a bond over the unsolved case.

faq.q: Does Smitts have any known family in Darkshire?
faq.answer: No family of Smitts is known in Darkshire. He keeps the Scarlet Raven on his own, and no relatives of his are known there.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler emerging from the shadowed woods, you can find shelter, drinks, and Smitts’s knowledge of the threats haunting Duskwood.
As a Rogue investigating cold cases and shadowy figures, you can rely on Smitts to notice what patrons write, when they panic, and what they leave behind.
